subject.title: feat(durable): add beta3 runtime core foundation

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this durable core and its persisted schema, remaining environment controls, CLI, and Gateway protocol as a release/2026.7.1 beta contract?
rationale: After the mechanical backend-selector defect is removed, the branch still establishes broad permanent core, operator, storage, and protocol commitments that implementation tests cannot authorize.

options.title: Sponsor the durable foundation
options.body: Approve the architecture, remove the redundant selector, and require exact-head upgrade, restart, delivery, and forward-port proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow the approved kernel
options.body: Keep selected storage and lifecycle primitives while deferring broader environment, CLI, and protocol surfaces.

options.title: Pause the stack
options.body: Hold the implementation until the open RFC and release ownership are explicitly accepted.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the durable foundation
recommendation.body: Approve the architecture, remove the redundant selector, and require exact-head upgrade, restart, delivery, and forward-port proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest feature history across the shared state DB, Gateway chat and protocol, subagent lifecycle, and Gateway run-loop ownership surfaces.
